name: GamerHoard
purpose: Biblioteca local de videojuegos: sesiones y tiempo jugado, catálogo RAWG opcional, seguimiento, DLC, estadísticas e importación de Steam.
notes: Local web app plus MCP tools over ONE library file (~/.gamerhoard/library.json, or GAMERHOARD_DATA_FILE). Run npm run setup once, npm run build:web once, then npm run server (or GamerHoard.bat, or let Faustus launch it): the app answers on http://127.0.0.1:5207 and the MCP server (stdio) shares the same file; each process re-reads it when the other writes. RAWG_API_KEY enables online catalogue search and the cover/metadata lookups of the web UI (the key stays on the server); Steam import and achievement sync take the key per call and never save it. Only local requests are accepted (GAMERHOARD_ALLOWED_HOSTS adds host names). The Faustus copilot button is injected into every page; set HOARD_COPILOT=0 to turn it off. Mutating tools: gamer_add, gamer_add_from_catalog, gamer_update, gamer_dlc, gamer_log_session, gamer_remove (needs confirm), gamer_import_json, gamer_import_steam and gamer_sync_steam_achievements.
